source_note: C01 portable generator (blueprint p.7: 6 PU, no fuel depletion, placed at the pump pad; pump OR pub, never both). Anchors are authored placement points; routes are the grid edges a placed generator can be cabled into from that anchor. Cables are authored curves between sockets (presentation only), never physics. position_cm are the V01 graybox anchors (content/world/alder_street.json markers of the same ID; test_V01 keeps them equal): VAN_BAY behind the van, PAD_PUMP and STORE_PUMP_HOUSE on the pump-house bay floor; a dropped or misplaced item snaps to the nearest free anchor (blueprint p.6).
